messages.S2「浄…化！」の加算コイン弱化で敵のコイン威力を下げ、味方のマッチを有利にする: A support-oriented Identity that lowers enemy Coin Power with S2 Puri…fy!'s Plus Coin Drop, helping allies win clashes. With at least 4 N Corp. Fanatics deployed, his own Coin Power also rises.
messages.加算コイン弱化: S2のⅠコインが表面で的中すると、次のターンに加算コイン弱化(: **Plus Coin Drop**: If Coin Ⅰ of S2 lands Heads, it inflicts Plus Coin Drop next turn (1 at lower Uptie, 2 at higher Uptie). Plus Coin Drop lowers the power of Plus Coins by its value for 1 turn. The more Coins a skill has, the bigger the reduction. It is especially effective against story bosses with many Coins. S2 is 1 Coin, so keep his SP high so it lands Heads.
messages.S2のマッチ勝利で精神力回復: S2はマッチ勝利時に精神力を回復する(低い段階で: **SP recovery on S2 Clash Win**: S2 restores SP on Clash Win (3 at lower Uptie, 5 at higher Uptie).
messages.N社編成で強化: バトルパッシブ「クソッ…。」(嫉妬×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): **Stronger in N Corp. teams**: The combat passive Bugger… (2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) grants +1 Coin Power while 4 or more N Corp. Fanatics, including himself, are alive (Uptie Ⅳ). Its other effect: when an ally dies, he loses 10 SP at the start of the next turn and gains 1 Blunt Power Up.
messages.釘と出血: S1「未熟な釘打ち」で釘と出血を付与する。釘は、ターン開始時に出血1: **Nails and Bleed**: S1 Gawky Nailing inflicts Nails and Bleed. Nails is a special Bleed that inflicts 1 Bleed at Turn Start and increases Bleed Count by the Nails value.
messages.S3「微弱な断罪」: 3コイン。各コインの表面的中で、ダメージ量の10%分の追加: **S3 — Infirm Retribution**: 3 Coins. Each Coin's Heads Hit deals additional damage equal to 10% of the damage dealt.
messages.サポートパッシブ「読経」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も高い味方: **Support passive — Cantillation (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Nails inflicted by the 1 fastest ally. Strong in combination with Faust's The One Who Grips.
messages.コインの多い敵スキルにS2を当てて加算コイン弱化を入れ、次のターンの味方のマッチ: His main job is to land S2 on enemy skills with many Coins to inflict Plus Coin Drop, making allies' Clashes easier the next turn. Apply Nails and Bleed with S1 while chipping away with S3. With 2 Envy Owned and at least 4 N Corp. Fanatics alive, the passive's +1 Coin Power applies. This is checked separately from the ally-death condition. Combined with the passive's SP loss, S2 is more likely to land Tails, so watch his SP after an ally dies.
